text_block_list.name: Show Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Now, the show is nearing its climax, and 
the next one is question 100! Here 
comes—the question!”

text_block_list.name: Show Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘A certain mountain railway running 
through the Alps is known as the "World's 
Most ○○ Express." What word fills in the 
blank?’"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I think... Trainer and I talked about this 
before! I definitely remember... wait, 
what was it again...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Like 'beautiful'? Because we're 
running surrounded by nature, or 
something... But could it really be that 
simple...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Maybe 'long'? Since it goes through 
a mountain range, the distance is that 
much further, or something like that...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The correct answer is... Ugh, please let 
it be right...!

text_block_list.name: Show Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘The correct answer is... the world's 
"slowest" express train! One theory says 
it slows down because it travels through 
dangerous mountainous terrain.’"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—That's it~! It was in that travel 
magazine, wasn't it? Even though I looked 
at it with Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—Ow-ow-ow! ...That makes 100 questions, 
maybe I've been overthinking it...”

Buena Vista thought so hard about the 
questions on the TV quiz special that she 
ended up giving herself a headache...
